rows.title: the title as written, without the id and without emphasis marks
rows.status: triage | backlog | ready | in-progress | in-review | done | cancelled | deferred | null
rows.condition: what the item waits on, or null
rows.type: bug | feature | task | spike | chore | question | epic | decision | documentation | null
rows.type_as_written: the word or phrase that says the kind, as written, or null

relations.kind: parent | child | blocker | blocks | related | duplicate | supersedes

rows.detail: the row's text beyond its title, as markdown, kept as written

evidence.quote: a short quote from the text shown

rows.reasoning: one or two sentences naming what you saw

notes: anything the engine should know about this chunk
reasoning: one to three sentences on what the chunk holds
